& binds weaker than == (as in C): A & 3 == 2 is A & (3 == 2) = 6 & 0, so p = false. r = true. || short-circuits: A >= 6 is true, so A / Z (a division by zero) is never evaluated and s = true. ! binds tighter than ==: (!A) == 0 is true.
